article.hook: You sense something tight behind everything - a quiet grip refusing to loosen. Pluto in Scorpio shows the power that runs deep, raw, and unshakable, even when it’s unseen.
article.lived: Pluto stays in Scorpio for about two decades, threading a generation through its slow burn. You’ll see it in how people lock their feelings behind ironclad promises or dig into secrets no one asked to share. It’s the friend who recalibrates every quiet moment into a test of trust, or the co-worker who rewrites your project after hours, convinced only their way transforms it enough.
article.turn: That intensity turns toxic when control becomes a siege and obsession a fortress. Holding tight to power can fracture the bonds it once protected. When you clutch too hard, you lose everything you meant to keep - no one wins a war fought alone.
moves: Call out one small control move and undo it today.
Share a truth you’ve kept hidden, no matter the fallout.
Let one intense feeling pass without trying to fix it.
